 WBBL 2026: Match 21, HH W vs BH W Match Prediction – Who will win today’s WBBL match between Hobart Hurricanes Women vs Brisbane Heat Women?
 The Hurricanes have yet to win a match this season.
 By CricTracker Staff Published - 13 Nov 2026, 19:21 IST 
 6 Min Read
 Brisbane Heat Women and Hobart Hurricanes Women. (Photo Source: Brisbane Heat Women and Hobart Hurricanes Women/X) Hobart Hurricanes Women will meet Brisbane Heat Women in Match 21 of the Women's Big Bash League 2026 on November 14 at Bellerive Oval, Hobart. This is a reverse-fixture, with the Heat having won the first encounter by four wickets.
 The Hurricanes are yet to win a match this season. The defending champions have played five games all season and have lost all five, and will be looking to get their first points on board.
 Meanwhile, the Heat have had a resurgence of sorts, and are currently on a three-game winning streak after losing their opening two games. They will be looking to extend their run into a meaningful finish.

 Bellerive Oval, Hobart: Pitch Report
 The pitch at the Bellerive Oval has played on the slower end this season, with both games played having seen help off the surface for the bowlers. Spinners have got grip and turn, while seamers have received help with the new ball. Batters have had to get their eye in early, with the ball doing all-sorts when new.

 Probable Top Performers from HH W vs BH W
 Probable Best Batter: Georgia Redmayne
 The Heat skipper has been in fine form with the bat, having scored 200 runs in five innings, at an average of 50. She has scored three half-centuries, including an unbeaten 74 off 50 balls to guide her side home in a tricky chase against the Melbourne Stars in their last encounter.
 Probable Best Bowler: Heather Graham
 Heather Graham has taken eight wickets in five innings at an average of 14.87. She has been one of the standouts for the Hurricanes despite their poor start to the season, and will be looking to continue the same form.
